I was just talking about you with my friend, talking about clever youth... He told me a story about some amateur soldiers who went raiding into the old tunnels. One got spooked by a noise and started shooting everywhere, another one threw a bad grenade and killed everyone in their group. Turns out my comrade didn't even need a tripwire in the end. Disappointing, he said. If you don't want to find yourself in a similar situation, take a shotgun and go to those tunnels at the chemical plant. If you can handle the enemy in such conditions, then cramped space will become your ally.}} ==Objectives== * Eliminate any 5 targets in the old cellars while using a [[Weapons#Shotguns|shotgun]] on [[Factory]] ==Rewards== * 25,400 [[EXP]] * [[Jaeger]] Rep '''+0.03''' * 89,000 [[Roubles]] ** 93,450 [[Roubles]] with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 97,900 [[Roubles]] with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 2× [[Burris FullField TAC30 1-4x24 30mm riflescope]] {{quote|Alive and well, I see? Well, now you're the apex predator in those dungeons.}} ==Guide== In this quest you have to kill any 5 targets in the underground on [[Factory]] while using [[Weapons#Shotguns|shotguns]]. Only the targets have to be in the area for the kills to count towards the quest. The only area that '''doesn't count''' is beneath the tank containers.
